in_arabic.name: Buhthah
in_arabic.long_meaning: Buhthah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. The name Buhthah is derived from the Arabic word 'Baithah', which means 'a place of refuge'. This name is often given to boys who are believed to possess great strength and the ability to protect and provide for their loved ones. The name is also associated with the idea of finding safety and security in times of need.
